name: otto_cycle_cengel
title: Air-standard Otto cycle, compression ratio 9.5 (Cengel exercise 9-37)
summary: Cold air-standard Otto cycle on ideal-gas Air (Cengel exercise 9-37). Specific heats are evaluated once at the intake temperature. The model returns the four states, the heat added, the compression and expansion work and the thermal efficiency.

verification.summary: Compared with the EES stored solution of 9-37.EES (no --ees-units; already Pa, J and K). compare_solution.py: 23 common variables, 11 differ (rtol=0.001); only in EES: 2; only in CoolSolve: 1. Largest printed relative difference 6.58e-03 on w_cp, from CoolProp cp(Air) at 35 °C (1006.70 vs EES 1005.13 J/kg-K). No enthalpy offset: enthalpy is not called.
verification.reference: EES stored solution of thermo_kuleuven/exercices/9-37.EES (25 values, EES X9.920)
verification.notes: compare_solution.py without --ees-units. 23 common variables, 11 differ (rtol=0.001); only in EES: 2 (cp, cv, not in the equation window); only in CoolSolve: 1 (R#). Printed maximum 6.58e-03 on w_cp and on w_exp. Above rtol 0.001, all from CoolProp cp(Air) at 35 °C (1006.696 vs EES 1005.127, 1.56e-03): k 1.17e-03, eta_otto and eta_th_otto 2.52e-03, T_2 and p_2 3.69e-03, T_3 and p_3 3.69e-03, Q_dot_comb 4.01e-03, w_cp and w_exp 6.58e-03. c_v is 3.89e-04. Solved temperatures are in K (T_1 = 308.15, T_4 = 800, T_3 = 1974.68). No enthalpy call, so no Air enthalpy offset. 12 iterations with the stored-solution initials; without them the compression block stops at MaxIterations. Square system, so no Diagram-window value was restored.
